tasks.title: Create model 'lab-config' and deploy 'custom-node'
tasks.instructions:
Create model `lab-config` and deploy the `ubuntu` charm with name `custom-node`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-config
juju deploy ubuntu custom-node --channel latest/stable
```

Verify that `custom-node` exists in `juju status`:

```bash
juju status
```
hints: Run `juju add-model lab-config` followed by `juju deploy ubuntu custom-node --channel latest/stable`.
tasks.solution:
```bash
juju add-model lab-config
juju deploy ubuntu custom-node --channel latest/stable
```

tasks.title: Configure application hostname on 'custom-node'
tasks.instructions:
Set the `hostname` configuration setting for `custom-node` to `worker-01`:

```bash
juju config custom-node hostname=worker-01
```

Verify the configuration key:

```bash
juju config custom-node hostname
```

tasks.title: Deploy 'helper-node' and reset its hostname to default
tasks.instructions:
Deploy a second application `helper-node` using charm `ubuntu`, set its `hostname=temp-host`, then reset it back to default:

```bash
juju deploy ubuntu helper-node --channel latest/stable
juju config helper-node hostname=temp-host
juju config helper-node --reset hostname
```

Verify that `helper-node` has its hostname reset to default:

```bash
juju config helper-node hostname
```
hints: Deploy with `juju deploy ubuntu helper-node --channel latest/stable` and reset using `juju config helper-node --reset hostname`.
tasks.solution:
```bash
juju deploy ubuntu helper-node --channel latest/stable
juju config helper-node hostname=temp-host
juju config helper-node --reset hostname
```
